entities.summary: Karl Friedrich Albrecht, Margrave of Brandenburg-Schwedt, a grandson of Frederick William of Brandenburg and son of Margrave Albert Frederick of Brandenburg-Schwedt, was a Prussian military officer and the Herrenmeister of the Order of Saint John.
